C-QA-INSTALLER-ARTIFACTS.Summary: Deliver both existing manual QA installers for a concrete unfinished owner-requested test, with exact identity/digest evidence and complete task-owned binary cleanup; ordinary PR dry-runs retain evidence only.
C-QA-INSTALLER-ARTIFACTS.Problem: Original CI:F-002 remains on main e68c06b6: release.yml manual-build packages macOS/Windows without a downloadable installer. Its earlier unapproved draft proposed generic14dayretention, which conflicts with the owner's TEST_ARTIFACT_HYGIENE rule. Necessary prerequisite N-QA-DRYRUN-ARTIFACT-HYGIENE is separately tracked: release-tauri.yml installs production-identity Mark.app, searches/kills by broad name, lacks normal Quit/finally deletion and retains completed-smoke DMGs14days. This prerequisite is linked to CI:F-002 without adding to the original77records.

Goals.R-1: After the existing successful manual QA checks/package boundary, collect the expected current-target DMG or NSIS installer and a manifest with actual checkout SHA, candidate SHA, run ID/attempt, platform/target, isolated product/bundle identity, concrete test-case ID, filename, size and SHA256. Fail on missing/empty/ambiguous/unsafe expected input. No unrelated workspace files enter staging.
Goals.R-2: Manual retained installer handoff is only for a real active named owner-requested unfinished test. Require one safe qa_test_case reference, never treat that input or workflow dispatch alone as proof of owner authorization/acceptance. Use a one-day expiry as a maximum safety net; delete exact remote artifact IDs when that specific test finishes or is cancelled, retaining recipes, metadata/digests and results. A completed generic PR/push/dispatch dry-run has no installer-retention exception.
Goals.R-3: Both QA package flows use unique run/source/platform-bound product and bundle identifiers, updater artifact creation off and expected platform bundle types. Never install over the owner's application or use its profile. Dry-run install smoke still mounts the produced DMG, installs its app under an exclusively owned /Applications path, clears its quarantine, launches through LaunchServices and proves the exact installed executable appears within the existing ten seconds.
Goals.R-4: Record artifact paths, identities, source/config hashes and binary digests before launch; record owned child PIDs immediately at launch and before further input. Use exact path/bundle/PID ownership, normal native Quit, verified process/window shutdown and finally cleanup. No broad pgrep/pkill, SIGKILL, permission changes or blind app restarts. Remove task-owned installed/built app, installer, executable and duplicate copies after the completed run, preserving evidence and dependency/toolchain caches.
Goals.R-5: Preserve all production tag authorization/signing/publishing jobs, action/tool pins, permissions, required check names/thresholds, platforms, counting and cache mappings. Preserve dry-run ad-hoc signature, full installed-app startup, size budget/summary and warning allowlist gates. Preserve the complete manual Rust test target through a compile-only metadata boundary and execution of every generated mark test harness with no test filter; identify/remove those task binaries too.

Constraints.Constraint: Original CI:F-002 plus explicitly named N-QA-DRYRUN-ARTIFACT-HYGIENE only. Root owns canonical queue, existing XML, lifecycle/archive/publication and remote deletion. The worker inventories only requested completed dry-run metadata; it never deletes remote artifacts or accesses unowned historical/production artifacts.

The existing draft was never approved. This revised first approval explicitly replaces its input-free/manual packaging-literal and blanket14dayinstaller-retention proposals where required by the owner's stronger hygiene policy. Existing build entry, checks, targets and unprivileged boundaries remain. Do not change C-QA-LOCAL-TAURI-TOOL, its helper or signing-boundary architecture.

Only manual-build may consume qa_test_case. It is a bounded case identifier, not arbitrary command/config/version/ref/signing input. All other release.yml jobs and tag dispatch reachability remain AST-identical. No actual workflow dispatch, release action execution, production signing keys, versions/tags/publication or repository protection changes.

Use Node built-ins and existing prepared tools. Native macOS adapters use exact NSRunningApplication identity for normal Quit and WindowServer ownership metadata; preserve system permissions and unrelated applications/services. Failure to quit/verify cleanup fails explicitly and records remaining paths/PIDs; do not force-kill or silently claim cleanup.

Installer collection reads only contained regular expected-identity files under the target bundle directory, rejects link/junction/parent escapes and copies exact measured bytes into a fresh owned staging set. Ignore clearly unrelated cached filenames; do not delete unowned historical outputs. Same-identity ambiguous files fail. Binary outputs stay out of evidence-only uploads.

Task ownership comes from unique planned paths, compiler artifact metadata, known main binary digests and created/changed output snapshots. Cleanup never recursively deletes the shared target/dependency cache or arbitrary /Applications entries. Cargo-cache worker hunks and all cache mappings stay unchanged here.

Keep manual checks and their effective failure behavior; add no retries/skips/timeout relaxations or coverage changes. The full Rust bin-mark test executable(s) compile with the original target/options plus --no-run/JSON metadata and then run all cases with the package cwd; no omission of unit cases or green surrogate command.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No release/deployment/dispatch, production signature change, new platform, remote retention from this goal alone, owner acceptance inference or image/save/runtime product modification.

No cleanup of production/unknown historical outputs or unrelated existing local QA builder smoke behavior. Do not treat an artifact name, window presence or static/mock native adapter as a completed native scenario.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Synthetic actual collector fixtures prove both target formats, exact copied bytes/digests/manifest/source/run/test identity; missing/empty/ambiguous/wrong-identity and link/junction escapes fail without staging unrelated files. Native adapter fixtures prove recorded identity/digest precedes launch, only exact owned process identity receives normal Quit, every success/failure path attempts verified finally cleanup and unknown apps/copies are preserved.

Rust harness fixtures prove compile metadata selects every bin-mark test executable, rejects missing/unsafe/non-test outputs, records binary identity before execution, runs the full harness with no filter, propagates compile/test failure and removes only owned executable/digest duplicates through finally. No real build/profile is needed for these source tests.

YAML AST comparison proves every production job/pin/permission/condition and every Cargo cache mapping unchanged. Existing manual checks stay ordered and effective; dry-run signature/install/ten-second startup/size/warning gates remain. Generic dry-run uploads only metadata/log evidence and removes own binaries; only successful case-bound manual handoff uploads installer+manifest with explicit missing-file failure and one-day maximum expiry.

Read-only inventory binds only requested PR271/272/273 completed dry-run DMG IDs/digests/head identities; root performs any exact remote deletion. Preserve warning evidence artifacts. Source tests and the inventory do not claim this run had a new owner-requested retention exception.

Run focused collector/lifecycle/workflow-control/preflight/governance/syntax checks, target/final GRACE and independent review. Native macOS smoke on the exact CI candidate, both platform manual artifact upload/download digest readback and owner installation acceptance remain explicit gates until separately authorized and observed. No source fixture substitutes for those outcomes.

Root reconciles M-046/V-M-046 and ordinary exact-candidate safety/CI/integration/Collecting bookkeeping. The original77denominator is unchanged; additional hygiene prerequisite stays explicitly linked and separately identified.
